name: gr_exists_indepSet_card_ge
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (d : ℕ) (h : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ d) : ∃ s : Finset V, G.IsIndepSet (s : Set V) ∧ Fintype.card V ≤ (d + 1) * s.card
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (d : ℕ) (h : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ d), ∃ s : Finset V, G.IsIndepSet (s : Set V) ∧ Fintype.card V ≤ (d + 1) * s.card
informal: A graph of maximum degree ≤ d has an independent set of size ≥ n/(d+1) — Uses Mathlib2.comb_colorable_of_degree_le at step 1 to get a colouring C : G.Coloring (Fin (d+1)); by pigeonhole (Finset.exists_lt_card_fiber_of... / sum of fibre sizes = n) some colour class has (d+1)·|class| ≥ n, and colour classes are independent.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj] (d : ℕ), (∀ (v : V), G.degree v ≤ d) → ∃ s, G.IsIndepSet ↑s ∧ Fintype.card V ≤ (d + 1) * s.card
